description: Claim boundaries drawn with characters the ASCII segmenter did not treat as boundaries.

notes: Allowed until 2026-07-27. Two ASCII assumptions, both of which the model controls the bytes for. A full stop with no space after it was not a boundary, because the guard that protects decimals and abbreviations skipped every terminator not followed by whitespace. U+2028 LINE SEPARATOR was not a hard break, because the hard-break class was \n alone while str.splitlines() treats ten characters as line breaks. Either one merges an uncited claim into a cited one, which is the whole bypass. The gate now splits on the full splitlines set and treats a capital, quote or bracket after a full stop as a new sentence while a digit or a lowercase letter is not.
